summary:
# NOTES: *Linda Carlton, Air Pilot* by Edith Lavell (Saalfield, 1931; Gutenberg #44862)
(Single book; no other books in text.)

## Setup / Ch I–II
- Linda Carlton, ~17, senior at Miss Graham's school, Spring City. Blue sports roadster (father's gift at 16). Eyes blue.
- Ted Mackay: tall, red hair, blue eyes, flyer, works at Spring City Flying School. Supports mother and helps put younger sister through High School.
- Ch I: Linda gets flight with Mackay in old biplane (not for visitors). Thinks "Amelia Earhart, Elinor Smith." Altitude 1600 ft then 2000 ft. Motor dies, tail-spin. Linda steps off first with parachute at 2000 ft; Ted follows. Both land safely.
- Ch II: Linda finds wreck. Ted invites her to school. Class-day Friday in June, twenty-two graduates, Miss Graham's. Linda's dance invite refused by Ted ("wouldn't fit in... no evening clothes"). Louise Haydock = president, Linda's best friend ("double l's"). Linda voted most popular girl; gets bracelet. Class prophecy: Linda and Louise will marry wealthy men. Sara Wheeler, Sue Emery mentioned. Pink roses, no card, from Ted (Linda learns later). Ralph Clavering: tall, rich (father's millions, Clavering oil), Harvard. Sister Kitty Clavering. Aunt Emily Carlton (raised Linda since mother died; disapproves of planes). Father Tom Carlton: wanderer, ranch in Texas, Egypt, S. America; didn't attend graduation.

## Ch III–IV
- Louise, Ralph, Maurice Stetson (Ralph's Harvard roommate, "prince of wise-crackers," crashed plane his dad gave him) come for picnic at lake near Grier's woods. Maurice drives 75 mph. Harriman "Harry" Smith (friend, engineering student). Jim Valier (thin, lazy), Dot Crowley (tiny blonde), Jackson Stiles, Joe Sinclair, Sue Emery.
- Treasure hunt: Ralph and Linda partners; Ralph wants them as tennis doubles team at Green Falls.
- Father arrives; gives Linda an Arrow Sport "Pursuit" biplane and hangar. Says he'd take care of her punishment as child (whooping cough incident). Plans: Linda gets private license, flies to Green Falls in August.
- Dinner: father vs Aunt Emily. Clavering family to Green Falls (Lake Michigan resort). Father warns: Ted Mackay's father worked for him in Texas, untrustworthy; Linda must keep away from Ted. Father leaves for ranch (Mexicans threatening).
- Friends visit to see plane; Maurice: "Lindy Junior." Stranger spotted near plane; boys chase him (red hair, big), fail.
- Ralph decides to learn to fly at Spring City Flying School, with Linda.

## Ch V–VI
- Ch V: Father drives Linda's car; Ralph drives her home. Lieutenant Kingsberry (ex-Army, school head). Father refuses Ted as instructor; H. B. Taylor (second instructor, condescending) assigned. Linda passes physical; doctor examines heart. Linda and Ralph start lessons. Ted in overalls, red hair.
- Ch VI: Inside loops, Immelman turns learned. Linda's solo flights. Linda's license given; Ralph too. Ted's farewell: he's leaving for job as salesman, plane construction co., Kansas City. Ted admits he sneaked to see plane. Ted's card given. He confesses flowers were his. Linda tells him father forbids friendship. Ralph jealous, says Kit wants them at Green Falls July 31, Midsummer Ball (fancy dress). Kit's pearls (fifty-thousand-dollar necklace, French jeweler box) to be brought. Man fixing shabby coupé near Linda's car.

## Ch VII–VIII
- Ch VII: Aunt Emily buys white flannel knickers and blue knitted silk sweater/helmet. Aunt takes train. Flight: Linda pilots, Ralph navigates. Ralph had necklace from safe-deposit vault. Waco plane follows them. Linda does loops (mentions Laura Ingalls record). Ralph loses necklace box (white velvet box, pasteboard outer, 3 rubber bands). Landed in horse pasture. Man from Waco (ordinary suit, hand in pocket, new hire at school) "found" box; Ralph gives him $20. Plane leaves.
- Ch VIII: Arrive Green Falls airport. Newspaper photo. Kitty opens box: empty. Linda offers to sell her Arrow for Kitty. Ralph calls detective (lawyer). Lieutenant Kingsberry says thief = unlicensed errand boy. Linda and Ralph take Pursuit to hunt thief. Airport 1: wreck report 15 miles away. Wreck = Waco. Ambulance: Linda sees unconscious man = Ted Mackay; faints.

## Ch IX–XII
- Ch IX: Ralph and Linda back to Green Falls. Linda: Ted not tall enough, black hair (?). Mr. Carlton arrives. Mr. Clavering: insurance may not cover air travel; Carlton offers $25,000. Plan to visit Ted at hospital, 25 miles from Green Falls.
- Ch X: Ted recalls: flying to Buffalo with new plane for company; spotted wreck; shot in left arm/shoulder by thief, who took new plane. Father = mother's disgraced husband; father dismissed for theft, later Texas ranch job. Nurse (probationer, pretty) believes Ted. Carlton & Ralph visit; accuse Ted; Ted screams "My mother is the finest woman..." Head nurse expels them.
- Ch XI: Linda sleeps; father back, leaves after supper. Carlton says Ted guilty. Linda asks about jail. Father mentions parachute jump Linda did with Lieutenant Kingsberry (Ted not named). Linda's car brought by Thomas. Canoe party planned.
- Ch XII: Linda phones hospital; Ted gone home. Talks to nurse (Carlton's name). Ralph reports detectives Greer; gas agent sold gas to red-haired man. Ralph & Linda quarrel; Linda refuses Ralph; goes with Aunt Emily. Louise fixes with Harry Smith for Linda; Ralph goes with Louise. Linda flies low, nearly hits wires; decides to establish Ted's alibi via company.

## Ch XIII–XV
- Ch XIII: Masque Ball at Casino. Linda as fairy Queen Mab (Aunt chose). Harry Smith (Robin Hood) partner. Louise: Egyptian princess, earrings. Dot: schoolgirl; Jim Valier: Uncle Sam. Ralph: King Arthur. Linda wins women's first prize; Ralph men's first. Ralph & Louise win dancing. Linda says wants to be seriously in aviation.
- Ch XIV: Morning swim; Louise proposes flying trip; Aunt Emily consents (four days; stop with friends). Aunt's wire to cousin in Kansas City hotel. Flight: Kansas City; Mr. Jordan (sales-manager) writes alibi: Ted at Winton Hotel lunch with salesmen, left for Buffalo ~3pm.
- Ch XV: Fly to Sunny Hills, Colorado (Louise's Aunt Margaret and Uncle John Stillman; six children). Roger (31, eldest, pilot), Elsie (baby, girl), Anita, Jennie (married), twins Dan & David (23). Dinner. Telegram from Aunt Emily: "Your father seriously hurt. Fly to ranch at once." Louise and Linda leave.
- Ch XVI: Engine trouble, forced landing in shrubbery; Louise sees gas low (Dan Stillman had flown Pursuit at night). Lunch from Mrs. Stillman. Walk; German with cart ("Nicht versteh'"). Nap. Linda's German: "Wo ghen Sie?"

## Ch XVII–XVIII
- Ch XVII: Stream swim. Louise finds shattered plane, thief's coat, necklace in cheap pasteboard box. Two dead men: thief and father (red hair). Camp-fire; pistol (father's request). Book "Father Means Well."
- Ch XVIII: Ted arrested at home by two detectives; Sam Hunter (company pilot, friend) arrives, shows Jordan's alibi; detectives leave. Ted flies to Denver, reaches Stillmans ~10 pm; Roger buys Ted's plane. Search next morning; German at shack: "Nicht versteh"; girls safe nearby.

## Ch XIX–XXI
- Ch XIX: Plane (Roger's new cabin monoplane) rescues girls; Ted and Roger. Ted examines Pursuit; wreck info passed. Louise leaves for station; Linda flies Roger's plane with Ted? (Roger & Ted fly to ranch; land on father's field). Mrs. Cates (housekeeper), Cates (husband). Dr. Winston: father fell from horse, unconscious, leg broken, internal injuries. Dr. Lineaweaver (St. Louis surgeon) on vacation.
- Ch XX: Ted: other dead man = his father. Linda flies at night alone to Louisiana seaport (Dr. Grayson's bungalow); Dr. Lineaweaver returns with her. Operation succeeds. Dr. Winston: father will live.
- Ch XXI: Father recovering; Aunt Emily visits. Linda flies Pursuit to Green Falls. Field Day (Labor Day): Linda enters flying exhibition; scores six inside loops; wins race (only feminine entry). Ted and Sam Hunter perform acrobatics; Ted parachutes from 5000 ft. Club award medal for life-saving flight. Louise arranged surprise. Father in wheelchair: approves Ted as friend. Last line: "My career as a flyer has only just begun!" THE END.
